nodes.description: KIFBP is a tetratricopeptide-repeat alpha-solenoid that binds the motor domains of a subset of kinesins, remodels them and blocks their microtubule attachment; it also interacts with actin filaments and microtubules. Its loss is expected to deregulate these motors and cytoskeletal interactions. This is inferred from normal KIFBP biochemistry; it should not be read as a uniform decrease in kinesin transport, and which deregulated motors matter for each disease feature is unknown. A primary mitochondrial respiratory defect is not supported: patient fibroblasts lacking KIFBP had normal respiratory chain activity.
